title: Supreme Court case tests limits of online privacy
summary_en: A dispute before the U.S. Supreme Court over the Video Privacy Protection Act could have significant implications for surveillance-based advertising and the future of internet privacy, says Neil Richards, a privacy law expert at Washington University in St. Louis.
title_cn: Supreme Court case tests limits of online privacy

title: Private equity owns less than 4% of U.S. hospitals, WashU research finds
summary_en: A new study led by researchers at Olin Business School at Washington University in St. Louis finds private equity only accounts for a small share of the nation’s hospitals, with most investors exiting within five years.
title_cn: Private equity owns less than 4% of U.S. hospitals, WashU research finds

title: Vaccinating moms protects offspring from deadly superbug
summary_en: A study in mice by WashU Medicine researchers advances efforts to shield infants from Klebsiella pneumoniae, a dangerous bacterium that causes severe bloodstream infections and is the leading killer of children globally.
title_cn: Vaccinating moms protects offspring from deadly superbug
